column1: # bridge/shlib/ampqmd.tsv: libomega-ampere-qmd.so.1, CUDApp's src/omega_ampere_qmd.c in Omega, from
# gpu/nvidia/om/encoder/amp_runtime.om, amp_qmd.om and bridge/shlib/ampqmd.om, one object. It needs the C
# library (memcpy and the pthread mutex). A trap answers -1, as the C does when its bridge call fails.
# Call rows: the policy with m NULL is refused (-1); the build with q NULL is refused (-1); the policy over buf
# (every byte 0xA5: no amp_runtime operation) is refused (-1) and writes nothing; a build that amp_qmd accepts (0),
# its ten arguments with registers and shared_bytes on the caller's stack and every narrow argument's upper 32
# bits set (AAPCS64 leaves them unspecified), and the 256 QMD bytes it writes to buf with the word after them;
# the same build as a policy request (op 3) at buf+1024 with q at buf+512 (0, the same QMD); and the policy with
# q NULL (0), which leaves m as it was. Every EXPECT and bufeq value is what CUDApp's C writes for the same
# arguments on the same buffer (an oracle outside this tree printed them).
